newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE signs $75 mln deal for Turkish army carriers.
newsitem.headline: UAE signs $75 mln deal for Turkish army carriers.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates army said on Thursday it signed several deals, including a $75 million contract with Turkey's FMC-Nurol for 136 armoured combat vehicles.
FMC-Nurol is a joint Turkish-U.S. venture.

The deals, announced at the end of the Gulf Arab state's IDEX 97 arms show, also included a 151.4 million French francs contract for seven helicopters from Eurocopter, a joint venture of France's Aerospatiale and Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA).
Under the deal, Abu Dhabi will buy five Gazelle and two Panther helicopters, Colonel Obeid al-Kitbi, UAE deputy director of arms procurement, told a news conference.
The UAE awarded in 1995 a $235 million deal to Franco-German Eurocopter for new helicopters and upgrades.

Other deals included a $3.6 million contract with Coleman Research Corporation, a unit of Thermo Electron Corp for the development of an Air Force decision support centre and a $1 million contract to develop a directorate of medical services.
Kitbi said the UAE also signed a 2.6 million dirham ($708,000) deal with a local firm for the installation of a computer networking, cabling and audio-visual system for the navy.
